content.short: UNITBOX fractionalizes the value of an NFT and leases NFTs for investors to rent.
content.description: UNITBOX is a rental marketplace that enables NFT owners to lend their assets to students and gamers for a fee. Web3 gamers can rent high-skill NFT-based characters to gain in-game advantages during sponsored tournaments, then return the assets to pay the rental fee after achieving success in their gaming ventures. The model creates a win-win: creators monetize idle NFTs while players access powerful characters without long-term ownership.
